speakers.name: Sac
speakers.background: Built the 3D game《小王子》alone in 16 days (rendered in Unity); does self-media (自媒体) and posts mainly on X; says classmates in university criticized his taste; describes himself as not knowing game development or 3D modeling and relying on AI for every technical decision; uses a Mac.
